title: The wait for the top flight ends.
deck: Albion reach the Premier League for the first time.
imageNote: A later view of the ground, photographed in 2013.
body: Automatic promotion in 2002 ended Albion’s 16-year absence from the top flight. Gary Megson’s team had turned a long period of second-tier struggle into a return to the highest division.

Darren Moore scored the opener in the decisive 2–0 home win over Crystal Palace. His first season at the club had ended with promotion. Follow his profile for another way through this period: two promotion campaigns, relegation and a part in the Great Escape all belong to the same Albion career.
